Pet Travel Notice for Travelers

Travelers with animals should check their travel papers, crate fit, and handoff plans before heading to the airport. Aurelia Skyways wants each companion trip to feel calm, careful, and straightforward.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk uses patient, humane handling for every animal, and trained staff keep watch for signs of stress. <<FACT F068>> If a crate or carrier needs review, the desk will guide you through the next step with steady, plain advice.

Bird travel needs special attention as well. <<FACT F077>> Please make sure the animal is ready for the full trip, and let the desk know about any health concerns, feeding needs, or comfort items that should stay with the crate.

If anything changes, the review is handled in a calm, stepwise way so travelers know what to expect. For help with your booking or pet check-in, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
